identity.evidence: Every page footer reads '© Copyright 2014 – 2024 | The Bar People Limited | Company Number: 12161824'. Companies House 12161824 (fetched) is THE BAR PEOPLE LIMITED: active private limited company, incorporated 19 August 2019, SIC 56210 event catering activities. Its registered office, 'Leytonstone House, 3 Hanbury Drive, London, England, E11 1GA', matches the directory address. The trade matches: the site sells all-inclusive, dry hire and cash mobile bars, staff and event management. The footer's 2014 start and the homepage '10 Years Of' rotating banner (page modified May 2024) match the directory's 'established 2014'. The site links instagram.com/thebarpeople, and the owner (Jake) confirms the business. Namesakes ruled out: 'The Mobile Bar People' (AddToEvent, South East) and 'The Bar Guys UK' (Berkshire) are different businesses. Two third-party profiles are probably older listings for the same business but do not link the site, so they are unverified: AddToEvent 'the bar people' ('London/Essex/Hertfordshire based', 'over 10 years') and WeddingPlanner.co.uk 'The Bar People' (Essex).

about.text: The Bar People is a mobile bar company based in London that brings its bespoke mobile bars to events anywhere in the country.
Its homepage lists five services: all-inclusive bars, dry hire, cash bars, staff hire and event management.
Its pop-up bars are modular and can be customised for indoor or outdoor use, in any size or colour. Listed sizes run from 5ft to a 40ft island.

For corporate events the company describes more than a decade of experience. It offers signature cocktails, branded bar setups and interactive cocktail stations, and handles everything from setup to cleanup.
For weddings it offers bar service for a few hours or the whole day, with custom cocktail menus, themed bar setups, mocktails and wine and beer stations.
Event management is presented as a team effort: Jake Lee covers corporate events and logistics, and Kim Knight covers private events and weddings.
Its cash bars are described as licensed to serve alcohol at any venue and take both cash and card payments.
Non-alcoholic drinks and mocktails can be added to any package, and all-inclusive packages include setup and takedown.
The company recommends booking at least three months ahead, particularly for peak dates, and says it also caters for last-minute events.
Eco-friendly bar options are offered, such as biodegradable straws and locally sourced ingredients.
The homepage 'We've Supported' section shows logos of Salesforce, Sky, O2, ITV2, EE, Batiste, Boux Avenue, Bulb and Crisis.
The business is run by The Bar People Limited (company number 12161824). The website footer carries a 2014–2024 copyright.

The Bar People Limited is an active private limited company, incorporated on 19 August 2019 under SIC 56210 (event catering activities). Its registered office is Leytonstone House, 3 Hanbury Drive, London E11 1GA.

services.name: All Inclusive Hire
services.description: One per-person price covers drinks, staff, bar, glassware, ice and setup, with unlimited drinks during the event. Published packages, verbatim: '50 Guests | 4 Hrs | All Inclusive £1495 /ex VAT' (2 x Bar People, beer, wine and spirits, 5FT Mobile Bar, fridge, ice, glassware); '100 Guests | 4 Hrs | All Inclusive £2995 /ex VAT' (4 x Bar People, 15FT Mobile Bar); '250 Guests | 5 Hrs | All Inclusive £6995 /ex VAT' (6 x Bar People, 30FT Mobile Bar, 2 x Fridge). The page notes that packages depend on availability, date, location and requirements.

services.name: Dry Hire
services.description: The client supplies the drinks; The Bar People provides the bar, staff, glassware and ice. Published packages, verbatim: '50 Guests | 4 Hrs | Dry Hire £695 /ex VAT' (2 x Bar People (4hrs), 5FT Mobile Bar, fridge, ice, glassware); '100 Guests | 4 Hrs | Dry Hire £1395 /ex VAT' (4 x Bar People (4hrs), 15FT Mobile Bar); '250 Guests | 5 Hrs | All Inclusive £2395 /ex VAT' (labelled that way on the dry hire page; 6 x Bar People (5hrs), 30FT Mobile Bar, 2 x Fridge). Indoor and outdoor events are both covered.

services.name: Cash Bar Hire
services.description: Guests pay for their own drinks. The company handles licensing, staff, equipment and a customisable menu, takes cash and card, and offers optional pre-purchased drink tickets or vouchers. A setup fee is charged and a minimum sales requirement usually applies. Published packages, verbatim: '50 Guests | Unlimited hrs | Cash Bar £495 /ex VAT' (2 x Bar People, 5FT Mobile Bar); '100 Guests | Unlimited hrs | Cash Bar £895 /ex VAT' (4 x Bar People, 15FT Mobile Bar); '250 Guests | Unlimited hrs | Cash Bar £1495 /ex VAT' (6 x Bar People, 30FT Mobile Bar).

services.name: Pop-Up Bars (modular)
services.description: 'Fully Customisable' modular bar setups for indoor or outdoor use, in any size or colour. Listed sizes: 5FT, 10FT, 15FT, 35FT, 40FT Island. Price shown verbatim: 'From £295'.

services.name: Event Management
services.description: Full event planning from start to finish: venue selection and coordination, vendor management (catering and entertainment), timeline management and on-site coordination on the day. Costs are itemised in proposals.

services.name: Corporate & Branded Bars
services.description: Customised bar services for corporate events, from product launches to gala dinners. Includes signature cocktails, branded bar setups and merchandise, interactive cocktail stations, professional mixologists and mobile bar units that fit any venue.

services.name: Festival Bars
services.description: Large-scale festival service ranging from extensive cash bars to all-inclusive packages with custom cocktails, professional bar setups and expert staff. Suited to music festivals, fairs and galas.

services.name: Glass Hire
services.description: Polished, wrapped glasses are delivered to the venue and collected afterwards, and can be returned dirty. Published per-glass prices, verbatim: 12oz £0.60, Margarita £0.80, Flute £0.60, Wine £0.60, Gin Bowl £0.80, Martini £0.75, Shot £0.50, 1/2 Pint £0.50, Pint £0.50, Whisky £0.65.

services.name: Staff Hire
services.description: Staff hire is listed as a core service in the homepage menu and service tiles. The staff-hire pages (/staff-hire/ and /services/staff-hire/) currently have no descriptive content.

services.name: Wedding Bars
services.description: Bespoke wedding bar service for a few hours or the full day. Includes customisable and themed bars, branded setups, custom cocktail menus, mocktails, wine and beer stations, and setup through clean-up.

record.instagramAccess: Verifier repeated one plain GET to https://www.instagram.com/thebarpeople/ with a desktop UA and no cookies. It returned HTTP 200 with no redirect (504,822 bytes). The page was the generic Instagram JS app shell: <title>Instagram</title>, no og:title/og:description/og:image profile meta, and 'login' strings throughout. No profile name, bio, posts or media were readable without logging in. Not retried. The site's own Instagram widget (homepage, and the Gallery page /4878-2/) renders no items server-side.
record.tagline: You bring the guests, we’ll bring the rest!
gaps: The directory price '£195 per head' does not appear anywhere on the official site. The site publishes package prices ex VAT and 'From £295' for pop-up bars instead, so the £195 figure should not be published as verified.

The street address is not on the website, which only says 'Based in the Heart of London, Serving Events Nationwide'. Leytonstone House, 3 Hanbury Drive, London E11 1GA is verified only as the Companies House registered office.

Founding year: the site implies 2014 (footer copyright 2014–2024 and a '10 Years Of' banner in 2024). The company was incorporated in 2019. Two third-party listings are not linked from the site and were not reconciled: a WeddingPlanner.co.uk profile says the business was 'born' in 2013 in Essex, and an AddToEvent 'the bar people' listing says 'London/Essex/Hertfordshire based' and 'over 10 years'.

No reviews, testimonials, awards or ratings were verified, so none are included. Warning: the site's /reviews/ page contains Avada e-bike demo testimonials ('Samantha Smith', 'Mark Strong', 'Lisa Monroe'), and /about-us/, the e-bike blog posts and the '+1 (800) 555 555' placeholder on /events/ are also theme demo content. None of it may be used as business facts.
No genuine vector (SVG) logo was found. The best available is Bar-People-Logo.png at 1000x1000 with transparency.
The 'Ask Marg' chatbot mascot (marg2.png 1024x1024, and margarita-1.svg) is a mascot, not the brand logo, and was excluded from logos.

Video contents were not visually verified because no files were downloaded beyond 1 KB range probes. Four media-library videos (D0CF2346, 263904B1.mov, 18944927, F521A64B) are not placed on live pages. Two of them sit on an Avada template page titled 'E-Bike Home', so their ownership is inferred from Apple-UUID naming and upload timing.
Excluded: halloween-party-promo-hero.mp4/.webm and halloween-party-promo-cta.mp4 in the media library. These are Avada theme demo assets, not this business's footage.

The media library also holds Avada demo stock images and logos (e.g. 2024/04/490-492.jpg, staff-01..06.jpg, studio-post-card.jpg, logo-avada-business-*.png, footer-logo.svg / ebike-logo-large.svg and the 2022–2023 hero/blog/team images). All were excluded.

circular_led.jpg (2024/02, 1024x769, an LED bar in a purple marquee) is unattached in the media library and appears on no live page. Its provenance is unclear, so it was replaced in images by batistebar.jpg from the live Corporate Events page.

The Gallery page (/4878-2/) is only an Instagram feed that renders no items, so no gallery photos are available from it. Many more own event photos (800x600) sit in the 2024/05 media library (e.g. salesforcebar, praxisbar, hewlettpackard, capsulecommsbar, weddingchigwell) if more images are needed.

Event photos are moderate resolution: most are 800x600 or 1000x1000. The 1600x600 banners (corporate_hero, alexbanner, weddingbars) have a darkened overlay baked into the file. Higher-resolution originals are listed in the images.

Several event-type pages (Engagement, Festivals, Retirement, Networking, Christmas, Charity) repeat the Corporate Events placeholder text. Birthday and Garden Party pages have their own text. Event types are taken from the site menu plus the Contact Us text ('milestone birthday, an anniversary', 'from festivals to private parties'); Product Launches comes from https://thebarpeople.co.uk/corporate-events/.

The Dry Hire page labels its 250-guest package 'All Inclusive', and its description says 20ft while the list says 30FT. Its 100-guest description says '10ft bar setup' while the list says '15FT Mobile Bar'. These are quoted from the list, not corrected. Both Staff Hire pages are empty.

The site footer's Facebook link has no https:// scheme. A plain request to facebook.com/thebarpeople returned HTTP 400, so the page is unverified beyond the site's own link. The site's LinkedIn link points to an admin URL. The public URL https://www.linkedin.com/company/5394184/ redirects (302) to a login page, so the company name behind it is unverified. The wa.me link returned 400 to a plain non-browser request.
No YouTube, Vimeo or TikTok channel is linked from the site, and web searches found none.
The site also lists a general enquiries email (hello@) and a second manager's direct phone and email (Kim Knight). These were deliberately omitted; only Jake's authorised contact details are used.
